Acrylic paintings, Montréal

Sonia Kouassi

"Sacred Heart of Jesus" Acrylic on canvas, 42 × 40 in. Painted with palette knife and brush.

A painter of quiet, sacred moments.

Sonia Kouassi is a Christian painter, wife, and mother of four. Her relationship with painting began in 2008 in Côte d'Ivoire, West Africa, where she taught herself to build images in acrylic on canvas using both palette knife and brush.

Her work draws on religious imagery and everyday scenes of family life. Each piece is an invitation to search for God — painted with thick, tactile layers of colour and close attention to the faces and hands where feeling lives.

She held two solo exhibitions in Côte d'Ivoire, in 2017 and 2018, both widely well received. In 2019 she moved to Canada, where she continues to give shape to her faith through her art.

Selected paintings

A collection of acrylic works on canvas, built up in layers with a palette knife and finished by brush — most exploring motherhood, fatherhood, and the search for God.

01

Our Lady of Tenderness

Acrylic on canvas · 40 × 60 in

The Virgin cradling the infant Jesus with tenderness. A comforting, quieting painting — the idea that a mother's tenderness heals.

02

Immaculate Conception

Acrylic on canvas · 80 × 100 in

A large-format tribute to the Immaculate Conception, worked almost entirely with the palette knife in deep blues and warm flesh tones.

03

I Will Never Abandon You

Acrylic on canvas · 36 × 36 in

Painted around a single line: even if father and mother abandon you, I, God, will never abandon you. A mother and child rendered almost entirely in tone.

04

Mother Teresa — My Motherhood Is Not of This World

Acrylic on canvas · 70 × 60 in

A tribute to Mother Teresa, mother of charity, and to every woman who is a mother without having given birth.

05

Saint Joseph, Marked by the Father's Character

Acrylic on canvas · 36 × 36 in

A tribute to Saint Joseph, father of Jesus, in whom God imprinted his own character — and to every father who is a father without having fathered by blood.

06

A Mother's Intercession

Acrylic on canvas · 36 × 40 in

A mother shown in supplication for her child before the face of the Lord.

07

Saint Joseph, Attentive Father

Acrylic on canvas · 36 × 40 in

Saint Joseph steadying Jesus through his first steps — a quiet study of patience and care.

A painting gifted to the Archbishop of Montréal

"Saint Joseph, Attentive Father" was presented to Monseigneur Christian Lépine, Archbishop of Montréal — one of several works placed in churches and private collections.

Available for commissions and exhibitions.
